title: [P0][EXTERNAL-EVIDENCE] L2–L6 independent target closure after protected PR #41 integration
body:
## Promoted immutable source — 2026-09-06

```text
promotion PR:               #41
reviewed source head:       7e1e611e7299391cf3d4edc1ded322da0d023cc6
reviewed/promoted tree:     04ba2fab66dfc41680784e1288e14c2fc54c58d9

protected main parent:      bb0f85e63b251b99a6fb490dfe6406a992d95f45
merge method:               GitHub protected squash
merged at UTC:              2026-09-06T07:07:45Z
commit signature:           GitHub verified / valid
changed paths reviewed:     929
source lane authority:      repository L1 only
zero_gap:                   false
public_release:             false
administrator_bypass:       false
automatic_redispatch:       false
```

PR #41 completed ordinary protected integration. `Franksudoman` approved exact head `7e1e611e7299391cf3d4edc1ded322da0d023cc6`; all inline threads were resolved. GitHub rejected the two-parent merge method on the protected path, so the permitted squash method was used with an exact-head lease. The resulting main commit is single-parent, signature verified, and carries the identical reviewed tree.

The stale `CHANGES_REQUESTED` state dismissed before merge was bound to old head `9420aac7ec2a8c88416f00115031885f72227ccc`; its audit text remains retained. No objection bound to the final reviewed head was dismissed, and no direct ref update or administrator bypass was used.

Post-merge main source, topology, gap-routing, compatibility, Android package/device and CodeQL workflows have been created for `968968046d69d000f1f9fe03683e92aa7903cf99`. Their results must be read from the actual runs; queued or pending jobs receive no evidence credit.

## Canonical gap truth

The checked-in register contains 21 gaps:

- 1 `CLOSED`;
- 13 `SOURCE_CLOSED_PENDING_EVIDENCE`;
- 7 `EXTERNAL_HOLD`.

Protected integration closes the repository admission blocker but does not itself transition an L2–L6 gap. Each transition still requires evidence at or above its declared exit level, exact source/target identity, retained raw observations, artifact digests, role separation, expiry and independent review.

## Required external sequence

### L2 — installed Root Linux / Provider / Codex

Kinds:

```text
installed_root_linux_process_matrix
installed_codex_same_turn
```

Require exact installed artifacts and signer identities; UID/GID, namespaces, cgroups, mounts, stores, supervisor and emergency inhibit; lifecycle and descendant cleanup; stream reconnect/cursor behavior; broker correlation and bounded multi-inflight behavior; concurrency and WL-01 through WL-12 baselines; and distinct producer, target custodian, reviewer and authorizer.

### L3 — clean Android target-files and image

Kind:

```text
clean_android_target_files
```

Require a clean pinned complete Android checkout, real Soong graph, init and SELinux compilation, selected package/product inventory, target-files and image digests, certificate/AVB inputs, exact installed component identities and independent custody/review.

### L4 — authorized physical device

Kind:

```text
physical_android_adb
```

Require explicit owner authorization, bound physical serial/hardware identity, real `adb devices -l` success/unauthorized/offline/disconnect observations, one bounded visible mutation, same-turn continuation, append-only intent/result records and ambiguity reconciliation before any later mutation.

### L5 — destructive fault matrix

Kind:

```text
destructive_fault_matrix
```

Require a sacrificial target and independent destructive authorization/operator; real process/provider/storage/ENOSPC/fsync/corruption/USB/reboot/power-loss cuts; pre-cut durable state; post-restart reconciliation; exact cursor boundaries; explicit unknown classifications; and automatic redispatch count exactly zero.

### L6 — signed release and OTA

Kind:

```text
signed_public_release
```

Require independently controlled production HSM/KMS custody with no key export, signer and certificate lineage, transparency, AVB chain and rollback indices, signed target-files/OTA digests, update/install/rollback-negative/staged-rollout/emergency-stop evidence and a distinct human release GO after every lower-level gap is validly closed.

## Admission and receipt rule

The repository target-evidence workflow is route-only on GitHub-hosted infrastructure. It performs no candidate checkout, target allocation, capture scheduling or evidence promotion. A route may proceed only when it binds the signature-verified promoted main commit/tree, merged PR #41, its exact-head independent approval, a successful exact-source check on the promoted commit, requested lane, actor, a genuine authorization ticket, expiry and one-use nonce.

Every accepted package must bind repository, promoted commit/tree, parent-package lineage, admission-request digest and consumed nonce, artifact/target/device identities, timestamps, commands or protocol steps, raw and redacted observations, assertions and negative tests, roles and authorizations, expiry and detached signature. Stale, synthetic, incomplete, cross-spliced, identity-drifted, unsigned or role-collapsed packages fail closed.

## Infrastructure visibility

A no-checkout GitHub-hosted inventory previously observed:

```text
environments endpoint: HTTP 200
visible environments:
  android-real-device
  owner-open-r5-l2
repository runners endpoint: HTTP 403
```

The runner 403 is an authorization limit, not proof of online or offline state. The automatic post-merge Android workflow may package the exact source on a hosted runner, but its device job earns credit only if the protected environment admits it, an eligible self-hosted device runner actually executes it, and the retained receipt passes content verification.

Keep this issue open until genuine, independently produced and reviewed L2–L6 packages close every canonical machine gap.
